answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 40009 Country: India Title: Please tell me how to convert hard water into soft water Question: Please tell me how to convert hard water into soft water? Is there any dua please let me know. Answer ID: 40009 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1216/869/D=1433) We could not find any dua to convert hard water into soft water. However the dua which is mentioned in hadith at the time of drinking water as thank you can supplicate with them including some dua words in it. اللهم اجعله عذبا فراتا برحمتك ولا تجعله ملجا اجاجا بذنوبنا . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
